formula.overlapRule: maximum applicable group multiplier unless the profile declares an ordered precedence list
formula.prohibition: The effective attention weight may control sampling or prior attention. It must not be inserted into textual specificity, source dating, fulfilment match or independence scores.

profiles.label: Evaluate every text individually
profiles.interpretation: Canon and exclusion history confer no automatic evidential bonus or penalty.

profiles.label: Protestant reception prior
profiles.interpretation: Models the authority judgment of a Protestant canonical boundary without calling that judgment empirical proof.

profiles.label: Ethiopian broader-canon reception prior
profiles.interpretation: Gives full sampling attention to the Ethiopian canonical family while retaining other ancient corpora as comparators.

profiles.label: Suppression or loss may hide valuable knowledge
profiles.interpretation: Upweights excluded ancient corpora to test whether the conclusion changes when marginalization is treated as a possible preservation failure rather than a reliability signal.

profiles.label: Communal filtering may have removed unreliable material
profiles.interpretation: Downweights noncanonical corpora to test the hypothesis that long communal selection retained the more reliable witnesses.

profiles.label: Ignore canon; weight only item-level historical evidence
profiles.interpretation: Every group multiplier is one. Subsequent item-level source date, manuscript date, specificity and independence fields do all evidential work.

warning: The numerical multipliers are scenario controls, not learned probabilities. Conclusions must be reported across profiles rather than selecting the profile that gives the desired answer.
